q1_issues.issue: (PartOf sk_students_1 sk_subgroups_1) makes the whole student group a member of a group of subgroups, whereas the text says individual students sit in various subgroups - a level mismatch.
"various" is dropped: the subgroup group carries no CardinalityPhrase or any other record of the stated vague plurality.

q2_gaps: subject-genitive of a nominalization ("the performance OF students", where the of-NP is the underlying verb's subject) - the complements rule covers only the object of-phrase and true relational nouns, leaving Possession as an unguided fallback

object-predicative "V NP as ADJ" ("tagged the state as deficient") - resultatives cover only bare-adjective results, and whether a designation of this kind may be flattened into a top-level (Member state deficient) is unaddressed
"various" as a plural determiner - not in the vague-quantity CardinalityPhrase lexicon and not covered elsewhere
sentence-initial discourse "But" with no second clause in the text - the adversative connective has no second endpoint to relate
notes: The name handling of "the federal No Child Left Behind act" is right - lowercase "act" stays outside the name and becomes a type atom - and Under is a licensed preposition-named oblique for the framing PP.
